# Diversity collections built into the Divbrowse docker-compose.yml by
# .github/workflows/populate-divbrowse.yml: one identifier per line, in service order.
# Blank lines and anything after # are ignored.

# Each collection must be one `lis-autocontent populate-divbrowse` can express: one VCF,
# a linked genome assembly with one annotation, and a single chromosome_prefix. If any
# can't be, the workflow fails with the reason and nothing is uploaded or announced.
